nativewind.compareDescription: className colors are token names only (no bg-blue-500). Mix freely with style; style wins on conflicts.
nativewind.spacingDescription: Uses Tailwind's rem-based scale. The bar below shows what 1rem is on this device.
nativewind.remMeasured: w-16 (4rem) measures {{width}} dp, so 1rem = {{rem}} dp (app spacing token: lg = 16)
nativewind.themeDescription: className reads colors from the current theme's CSS variables. Switch the theme above and colors change without writing dark: variants.
nativewind.textDescription: The app's Text always sets font, size and color through style, so typography classes on Text have no effect. Use variant / color / weight.

responsive.hookDescription: Computed from the current window size and updated on rotation.
responsive.barLabel: Bar width wp(50) = half the screen width
responsive.staticDescription: wp / hp remember the screen size at launch and do not change on rotation. Use useResponsive() on screens that rotate.
